text: 鲸鱼娘（Whale Girl）是面向 DSH 网页客户端的视觉主题插件。它为界面应用成套的浅色与深色调色板和鲸鱼娘壁纸，并通过皮肤管理器协议提供可调外观。用户可调整磨砂模糊、面板与气泡透明度、壁纸显示与遮罩、壁纸模糊及输入框聚焦光晕；参数即时作用于当前浏览器。适合想个性化 DSH 网页界面、切换鲸鱼娘风格的用户。需要 DSH Web 客户端；不需要额外 API Key。

Whale Girl adds light and dark palettes, a character wallpaper, and adjustable frosted styling to DSH web. Settings control blur, opacity, wallpaper, and focus glow. Changes apply in the browser; no API key is needed.
想给 DSH 网页界面换成带插画壁纸的主题。
有没有能调整网页聊天界面磨砂和透明度的皮肤？
让 DSH 的浅色和深色外观都使用同一套自定义配色。
我想在设置里实时调节聊天背景壁纸的显示效果。
DSH 网页版能不能加个带可调壁纸和面板效果的主题？
如何修改 DSH 输入框聚焦时的颜色光晕？
I want a character wallpaper and coordinated colors in the DSH web interface.
Can I adjust the frosted surfaces and chat wallpaper in DSH?
Give my DSH web client a matching light and dark theme.
鲸鱼娘（Whale Girl）的「浅深色主题」功能：为 DSH 界面提供配套浅色和深色令牌。插件启用时应用覆盖令牌，并随当前外观重绘界面样式。
鲸鱼娘（Whale Girl）的「外观参数」功能：在皮肤设置中调节模糊、透明度、壁纸及聚焦光晕。滑杆或开关修改后立即更新样式并保存到浏览器。
Whale Girl feature “Wallpaper”: toggle the chat wallpaper and adjust blur and veil; settings apply immediately.
Whale Girl feature “Skin controls”: registers seven appearance settings for the skin manager to apply in the browser.

dsh-whalegirl README · dsh-whalegirl · 鲸鱼娘：DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web GUI 的**鲸鱼娘**皮肤，接入 [skin-manager](https://github.com/Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale) 的皮肤协议。

视觉源自 [DreamSkin](https://dreamskin.cc/themes/ver_cb557ececaa5de3f3dbe) 的鲸鱼娘皮肤包，由 [ZHOUcourier/dsh-theme-whalegirl](https://github.com/ZHOUcourier/dsh-theme-whalegirl) 首次移植到 DSH，本仓库将其重制为**可被皮肤管理器发现、切换、调参**的独立皮肤包，并补齐了深色外观。

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

dsh-whalegirl README · 特性：- **完整的 174 个 `--dsw-*` 令牌重映射** —— 表面、文字、边框、按钮、代码块、滚动条、状态色全部由统一调色板推导，不是零散打补丁。
- **浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统三态** —— 两套调色板通过 `theme.overrideTokens()` 成对提交（`{ light, dark }`），由 presenter 按当前外观自行选取，**不会改写你的外观偏好**。
- **壁纸只铺在对话列** —— 鲸鱼娘作为对话区的 `background-image`，侧栏、插件页、设置页保持自身的实底，不会出现"壁纸跑到别处"。
- **7 项实时参数** —— 在「设置 → 皮肤管理」里拖动即时生效，无需刷新。
- **可被皮肤管理器管理** —— 提供 `skin.json` 与 customization 协议 v2，与「深海女仆工坊」「虎鲸链路」等皮肤互斥切换，启动时由管理器兜底。

dsh-whalegirl README · 安装：需要已安装皮肤管理器 `@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-deep-whale-manager`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add '@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-deep-whale-manager'
dsh plugin --profile web add 'dsh-whalegirl'
```

从 GitHub Release 的预构建包安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add -w https://github.com/zhenhua520/dsh-whalegirl/releases/latest/download/dsh-whalegirl.tgz
```

从本地目录 / 压缩包安装：

dsh-whalegirl README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add -w /path/to/dsh-whalegirl
dsh plugin --profile web add -w /path/to/dsh-whalegirl-1.0.19.tgz
```

安装后重启一次 DSH：

```sh
dsh web
```

然后在 **设置 → 皮肤管理** 里选择「鲸鱼娘」。

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-whalegirl
```

dsh-whalegirl README · 可调参数：设置 → 皮肤管理 → 鲸鱼娘。全部实时生效，按 `skinId` 保存在浏览器 `localStorage`。

| 参数 | 范围 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 主框背景模糊 | 0–24px | 4px | 应用主框毛玻璃的半径；0 = 完全关闭 |
| 表面透明度 | 0–100% | 45% | 0 = 面板全不透明，100 = 原版半透设计 |
| 用户气泡透明度 | 0–100% | 70% | 用户消息气泡的透出程度 |
| 壁纸遮罩浓度 | 0–100% | 58% | 盖在插画上的纸色薄纱强度 |
| 显示环境壁纸 | 开/关 | 开 | 关闭后回到纯净纸面 |
| 壁纸模糊 | 0–16px | 0px | 插画本身的锐度（不影响文字） |
| 输入框聚焦光晕 | 开/关 | 开 | DreamSkin 原版的咖啡色聚焦描边 |

> **壁纸模糊**控制的是插画锐度，**壁纸遮罩**控制的是插画显不显眼。想让鲸鱼娘更清楚就降前者，想让文字更稳就升后者。

dsh-whalegirl README · 外观三态：皮肤不改写你的外观偏好：

| 你在「设置 → 通用 → 外观」里选 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 浅色 | 鲸鱼娘浅色版（纸面 + 长春花蓝） |
| 深色 | 鲸鱼娘深色版（深蓝紫 + 浅字） |
| 跟随系统 | 随系统明暗实时切换 |

实现上通过 `theme.overrideTokens()` 一次提交两种模式的值，因此 `preference` 始终是你选的那个，不会被插件覆盖。

dsh-whalegirl README · 兼容性：- 需要 DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`
- 需要 `@deepseek-ai/cordis ^4.0.1`、`react >=18`
- 仅 Web 客户端（`dsh.client.platform: "web"`）
- 与 skin-manager 生态的其它皮肤互斥切换；未安装管理器时也能单独工作（退回注册一个亮色主题）

1. **一创 上善**（[Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/users/62155430) · Bilibili：上善无形）—— 角色形象原作者
2. **二创 ZipZipPipe**（[Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/users/18604994)）—— 加入 DeepSeek 元素的二次设计

4. **移植 ZHOUcourier** —— 首次移植到 DSH（`dsh-theme-whalegirl`），本包继承其调色板锚点、壁纸与 CSS 生成逻辑

本包新增：skin-manager 接入（协议 v2 / `skin.json` / 实时参数）、深色调色板、外观三态映射、壁纸收敛到对话列、以及行内代码/改动卡片/滑杆/反色徽标的对比度修正。

完整说明见 [NOTICE](NOTICE)。

dsh-whalegirl README · 语法检查：node --check lib/client.js

dsh-whalegirl README · 打包（无需构建步骤，lib/ 已随包提交）：tar czf dsh-whalegirl.tgz package.json skin.json cordis.patch.yml lib assets README.md README.en.md LICENSE
```

结构：

```
package.json          dsh.bundle + dsh.client + peerDependencies
skin.json             皮肤管理器发现所需的元数据
cordis.patch.yml      bundle 自身的 insert 行
lib/index.js          host 半（空 apply，纯视觉插件）
lib/client.js         浏览器半：调色板、CSS、协议、参数
assets/background.jpg 壁纸（同时以 base64 内嵌进 client bundle）
```

dsh-whalegirl README · dsh-whalegirl · Whale Girl：A **Whale Girl** skin for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web GUI, wired into the [skin-manager](https://github.com/Small-tailqwq/dsh-deep-whale) customization protocol.

Artwork comes from the DreamSkin Whale Girl package; [ZHOUcourier/dsh-theme-whalegirl](https://github.com/ZHOUcourier/dsh-theme-whalegirl) first ported it to DSH. This package rebuilds it as a proper **discoverable, switchable, tunable** skin and adds a dark variant.

English | [中文](README.md)

dsh-whalegirl README · What it does：- **Full 174-token `--dsw-*` remap** — surfaces, labels, borders, buttons, code blocks, scrollbars and state colors all derive from one palette instead of scattered patches.
- **Light / dark / follow-system** — two palettes submitted as `{ light, dark }` pairs through `theme.overrideTokens()`, so the presenter picks the right one and **your appearance preference is never rewritten**.
- **Wallpaper confined to the conversation column** — the artwork is a `background-image` on the chat column only; sidebar, plugin page and settings keep their own solid background.
- **7 live parameters** — drag in Settings → Skins, applied instantly with no reload.
- **Managed by skin-manager** — ships `skin.json` and customization protocol v2, switches mutually exclusively with other skins.

dsh-whalegirl README · Install：Requires the skin manager:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add '@smalltailqwq/dsh-client-ui-skin-deep-whale-manager'
dsh plugin --profile web add 'dsh-whalegirl'
```

From a GitHub Release tarball:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add -w https://github.com/zhenhua520/dsh-whalegirl/releases/latest/download/dsh-whalegirl.tgz
```

From a local directory or tarball:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add -w /path/to/dsh-whalegirl
dsh plugin --profile web add -w /path/to/dsh-whalegirl-1.0.19.tgz
```

dsh-whalegirl README · Install：Restart DSH once, then pick **Whale Girl** under Settings → Skins.

```sh
dsh web
```

Uninstall:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-whalegirl
```
dsh-whalegirl README · Parameters：Settings → Skins → Whale Girl. All live, persisted per `skinId` in browser `localStorage`.

dsh-whalegirl README · Parameters：| Parameter | Range | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Frame blur | 0–24px | 4px | Frosted-glass radius on the app frame; 0 disables it |
| Surface opacity | 0–100% | 45% | 0 = fully opaque surfaces, 100 = original semi-transparent look |
| Bubble opacity | 0–100% | 70% | How much the user bubble lets through |
| Wallpaper veil | 0–100% | 58% | Strength of the paper wash over the artwork |
| Show wallpaper | on/off | on | Turn off for a plain paper background |
| Wallpaper blur | 0–16px | 0px | Sharpness of the artwork (never affects text) |
| Composer focus glow | on/off | on | DreamSkin's coffee-accent focus ring |

dsh-whalegirl README · Parameters：> **Wallpaper blur** controls artwork sharpness; **wallpaper veil** controls how prominent it is. Lower the former to see the artwork, raise the latter to steady the text.

dsh-whalegirl README · Appearance states：The skin never rewrites your preference:

| Settings → General → Appearance | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Light | Whale Girl light (paper + periwinkle) |
| Dark | Whale Girl dark (deep blue-violet + light text) |
| System | Follows the OS in real time |

Implemented with `theme.overrideTokens()`, which submits both modes at once — `preference` stays exactly what you picked.

dsh-whalegirl README · Compatibility：- DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`
- `@deepseek-ai/cordis ^4.0.1`, `react >=18`
- Web client only (`dsh.client.platform: "web"`)
- Switches mutually exclusively with other skin-manager skins; also works standalone (falls back to registering a light theme)

**Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International**;
see [LICENSE-ARTWORK](LICENSE-ARTWORK). **Commercial use is not permitted.**
Derivatives must keep the same license and the full attribution chain.

dsh-whalegirl README · Attribution chain：The Whale Girl character and every image asset are derivative works. In
order of creation:

1. **上善** — original character design ([Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/users/62155430))
2. **ZipZipPipe** — DeepSeek-flavored derivative design ([Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/users/18604994))
3. **Small-tailqwq** — redesign for the `dsh-deep-whale` skin family
4. **ZHOUcourier** — first DSH port (`dsh-theme-whalegirl`); this package inherits its palette anchors, wallpaper and CSS generation

dsh-whalegirl README · Attribution chain：Added by this package: skin-manager integration (protocol v2, `skin.json`,
live parameters), a dark palette, appearance-state mapping, wallpaper
confined to the conversation column, and contrast fixes for inline code,
changed-file cards, sliders and the inverted brand badge.

See [NOTICE](NOTICE) for the full statement.

node --check lib/client.js

tar czf dsh-whalegirl.tgz package.json skin.json cordis.patch.yml lib assets README.md README.en.md LICENSE
```
